purpose: Everything about one item, and the action to take on it.
layout: A large hero (photo or big title block) at the top, then key facts in a compact row (rating, price, time), then descriptive sections. A sticky bottom bar holds the price or summary and the primary button.

required: Sticky bottom bar with the primary action

primaryAction.note: Filled button in a sticky bottom bar, with the price or total beside it.

avoid: The primary button scrolled out of reach
Repeating the title in hero and header

variants.layout: Photo hero: full-bleed image at the top, content sheet overlapping its bottom edge with rounded top corners.
Title first: large title and key facts at the top, then a horizontal gallery strip of images, then sections.
Split facts: a compact header with thumbnail beside the title, then a two-column facts table, then description and related items.
